newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Lexington County, S.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Lexington County, S.C..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
$15,615,000* GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1997
OF LEXINGTON COUNTY, SOUTH CAROLINA

Time and Place of Sale: Proposals for the purchase of $15,615,000* General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997, of Lexington County, South Carolina (the "Bonds") will be received at the offices of Lexington County, County Council Chamber on the sixth floor of the Lexington County

Administration Building, 212 South Lake Drive, Lexington, South Carolina 29072 until 12 noon, South Carolina time, on Thursday, January 23, 1997. Terms and conditions of sale will be governed by the Official Notice of Sale.
Bonds: The Bonds will be issued initially under the DTC Book-Entry Only System. The Bonds will be dated as of

January 15, 1997, will bear interest at such rates as are specified by the original purchaser in its bid payable on each February 1 and August 1 beginning August 1, 1997, and will mature serially on February 1 in each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:
Principal Principal
Year Amount* Year Amount*
* Preliminary, subject to adjustment as set forth in Official Notice of Sale Redemption:The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their maturity.

Security: The Bonds shall constitute binding general obligations of the County and the full faith, credit, resources and taxing power of the County are irrevocably pledged for the payment of the Bonds.

Bid Requirements/Award: The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder or bidders offering to purchase the Bonds at the lowest true interest cost to the County. A bid for less than all the Bonds, or a bid at a price less than par, or for more than $10,000 over par, will not be considered.

Bidders shall specify the rate or rates of interest per annum which the Bonds are to bear, to be expressed in multiples of 1/20 or 1/8 of 1% with no interest rate for a maturity of Bonds less than the interest rate specified for any previous maturity.
Good Faith Check: A good faith check in the amount of
$156,150 payable unconditionally to the Treasurer of
Lexington County, South Carolina is required or in lieu of providing a good faith check, a bidder may use the Sure bid system.
Continuing Disclosure: A description of the County's
undertaking and the form of the Continuing Disclosure Certificate are set forth in the preliminary Official
Statement dated January 13, 1997, and also will be set in the final Official Statement.
Legal Opinion: The legality of the Bonds will be approved by Sinkler & Boyd, P.A., Bond Counsel, Columbia, South Carolina.
Additional Information: Persons seeking information or copies of the preliminary Official Statement should
communicate with Brent Jeffcoat, Esq.; Sinkler & Boyd, P.A.; P.O. Box 11889; Columbia, South Carolina 29211- 1889, (telephone (803) 540-7874).
(From The Bond Buyer)
